-- Scenario 73a: SAP publishes ~60 new October notifications (no schema change).
-- Expected: both pipelines pick the rows up on their next refresh; banner stays green.
insert into {{DEMO_L0}}.PUBLISHER.MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  (MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION, EQUIPMENT, NOTIFICATIONTYPE, PRIORITY, CREATEDON, DOWNTIMEHOURS, NOTIFICATIONTEXT)
select 'N-' || lpad(1000 + n, 6, '0'), 'E-' || (1001 + mod(n * 3, 10)), iff(mod(n, 4) = 0, 'M2', 'M1'), to_varchar(1 + mod(n, 4)),
       dateadd(day, mod(n * 5, 22), '2026-10-01'::date), (2 + mod(n * 29, 150) / 10)::number(10,2), 'October notification ' || n
from (select row_number() over (order by seq4()) as n from table(generator(rowcount => 60)));

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('73a', 'SCENARIO_RUN', null, 'SAP published 60 October notifications (data only, no schema change)', 'PRESENTER');
